title: Policy Nudger
description: Use this schema twice: (1) a BASE profile with preference domain com.lbg.policynudger for shared settings, scoped to all Macs; (2) one NUDGE profile per policy with domain com.lbg.policynudger.<name> (e.g. com.lbg.policynudger.zoom), scoped like that policy. Keys set in a nudge profile override the base. Keys marked "Nudge profile only" are never inherited from the base.

NudgeID.title: Nudge ID
NudgeID.description: Nudge profile only. Unique name for this nudge. Change it to start a fresh nudge (resets first-seen date and deferral count). Letters, numbers, . _ - only. Defaults to the trigger. Must be unique across nudge profiles.

PolicyTrigger.title: Policy custom trigger
PolicyTrigger.description: Nudge profile only. Custom event of the Jamf Pro policy to run (set the policy frequency to Ongoing).

PolicyID.title: Policy ID
PolicyID.description: Nudge profile only. Alternative to the custom trigger: the Jamf Pro policy ID. Ignored if a trigger is set.

PolicyName.title: Policy name (shown to users)
PolicyName.description: Nudge profile only. Friendly name used in dialog text as {policyName}.

CompletionCheckPath.title: Completion check path
CompletionCheckPath.description: Nudge profile only. Optional. If this path exists the nudge is treated as complete, e.g. /Applications/zoom.us.app.

CompletionCheckVersion.title: Completion check minimum version
CompletionCheckVersion.description: Nudge profile only. Optional. Minimum CFBundleShortVersionString of the app at the completion check path.

EnforcementDays.title: Enforcement (days)
EnforcementDays.description: Days from when the nudge is first seen on a Mac until the policy is forced. Added to Enforcement (hours).

HardDeadline.title: Hard deadline
HardDeadline.description: Nudge profile only. Optional absolute deadline in local time, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM. The earlier of this and the relative enforcement wins.

DeferralOptions.title: Deferral options
DeferralOptions.description: Comma-separated choices offered to the user, in hours (h) or days (d), e.g. 1h,4h,1d,2d. Choices past the deadline are hidden.

MaxDeferrals.title: Maximum deferrals
MaxDeferrals.description: 0 = unlimited until the deadline. Once used up, the next reminder enforces the install.

PromptTimeoutMinutes.title: Prompt timeout (minutes)
PromptTimeoutMinutes.description: An unanswered nudge closes after this long and counts as the shortest deferral (not counted against the maximum).

EnforcementCountdownMinutes.title: Enforcement countdown (minutes)
EnforcementCountdownMinutes.description: Countdown shown at the deadline before the install starts.

MeetingGraceMinutes.title: Meeting grace (minutes)
MeetingGraceMinutes.description: At the deadline, how long to wait for a call or presentation to end. If it has not ended, the policy installs silently without a dialog.

FailureRetryMinutes.title: Retry after failure (minutes)
FailureRetryMinutes.description: How long to wait before trying again after a failed install.

MeetingProcesses.title: Meeting processes
MeetingProcesses.description: Comma-separated process names that mean the user is in a call (CptHost = Zoom meeting).

AssertionIgnoreList.title: Ignored display-sleep assertion owners
AssertionIgnoreList.description: Comma-separated process names whose display-sleep assertions do NOT count as being in a meeting.

Icon.title: Icon
Icon.description: swiftDialog icon: local file/app path or SF Symbol (SF=name).

Title.title: Title
Title.description: Placeholders: {policyName} {deadline} {timeRemaining} {deferralsRemaining} {deferralsUsed} {maxDeferrals} {countdown} {userFirstName} {userName} {button1Text} {button2Text} {supportTeamName} {supportTeamPhone} {supportTeamEmail} {supportTeamWebsite} {computerName} {serialNumber} {nudgeID}. Leave blank for the built-in default.
